title: Dependencies
subtitle: Every package your repositories depend on — where, at which version, and how far behind the latest release.

start.title: Scan your repositories' dependencies
start.body: Reads package.json, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml / requirements*.txt, go.mod and pom.xml anywhere in each repository (monorepos too; node_modules, vendor and build folders are skipped). One request per repository plus one per manifest — repeat scans are nearly free.

latest.privacy: Asks npm, crates.io, PyPI, the Go proxy and Maven Central for the newest releases — only package names are sent, never your token or code.
latest.hint: Check latest versions to see what's outdated.

error.notFound: Not on the public registry (private or renamed)

openManifest: Open the manifest in Files & Editor

allowed.name: Within range
allowed.what: a newer release exists, and the declared range already accepts it

major.name: Major behind
major.what: a new major version — may need changes to upgrade

local.name: Local
local.what: a path, git or workspace link — not from a registry

truncated: Very large repositories, not every manifest read: {{list}}
toolGuess: no lockfile or packageManager field found — assumed

bump.title: Bump {{name}}
bump.prBody: Updates the declared version (made with ZIT-Suite). Lockfiles are refreshed by the next install ({{manager}}) — CI on this PR shows whether everything still builds.
bump.lockNote: Manifests only — the lockfile updates on the next install.
bump.noneEditable: None of its manifests can be edited here (only package.json, Cargo.toml and requirements*.txt).
bump.someSkipped_one: {{count}} use left out: a local / workspace link or a manifest type we don't edit.
bump.someSkipped_other: {{count}} uses left out: local / workspace links or manifest types we don't edit.
